**Deadhead — Gold Line play surface** (Director notes).

World Scene inject (flag `goldLineScene`) creates **Scenes → Deadhead → Gold Line** on first GM load.

| Role | Default | Optional loops |
|---|---|---|
| Interior background | `…/map-gold-line-interior.webp` | `…-loop.mp4` / `…-loop.webm` |
| Roofs overhead tile | `…/map-gold-line-roofs.webp` | `…-loop.mp4` / `…-loop.webm` |

**Stills are the default** until video is proven. Loops stay in the folder. **Stills are a valid playable layout** (same 6472×958 plate and 208 / 5 ft grid). Do not drop a generated train.

**Plate:** 6472 × 958. **Grid:** 208 px = 5 ft (~31.1 × 4.6 squares). Art has **no baked grid**. Hull ~20 ft wide.

**Roofs (Michael lock 2026-09-20):** **Tiles** layer, name **Roofs (overhead)**. Place **x=3232, y=475**, size **6472×958**, elevation **1**, **locked**, occlusion **FADE** (mode 1, alpha 0). Roofs **clear under tokens**. Do not use Surface (mode 2) unless verified on this stack.

x/y are **not 0,0**: the Level background is pinned to the scene origin. A Foundry Tile’s x/y is its **registration point** (center), so a full-plate roof sits near (width/2, height/2) ≈ (3236, 479). Michael nudged that to 3232, 475. Resetting to 0,0 shifts the roof by half a plate. Elevation 1 (not 10) so Levels does not hide the tile and FADE sits above tokens at 0.

**Lock:** CyberMaps Hammerhead dual stitch. Do not drop a generated train plate on this Scene.

Source of truth: `docs/directors/runs/deadhead/DEADHEAD-GOLD-LINE.md`. If roofs drift: as GM run `await game.ghostwire.ensureGoldLineScene({ force: true })` then re-activate the Scene.

text.markdown:
Design truth is still **5 cars**: cab · courier · security · passenger · tail. The shipped plate is **2 × 3 Hammerhead chambers**, left → right = aft → forward (nose right). Crew boards **aft** and works **upstream** (rightward).

| Plate zone (L→R) | Hammerhead part | Deadhead beat |
|---|---|---|
| **L1** | Left aft cargo | **TAIL** — board here (drone sling) |
| **L2** | Left connector | **PASSENGER** — civilian clutter / Enforcers |
| **L3** | Left forward + cab | **SECURITY** — treat mid cab as sealed ARG booth / Lt nest; play the cargo bay |
| *(coupler)* | Synthetic join | Non-walkable or Maglock gangway (Director call) |
| **R1** | Right aft cargo | **COURIER** — sealed capsule stacks |
| **R2** | Right connector | Transfer / Wire closet (cams/doors node) |
| **R3** | Right forward + cab | **CAB** — drive end; Trace host fiction |

**Wire on this plate:** Track 1 cams/doors **R2**; Track 2 capsule lock **R1** + Watchdog ICE.

If you need a clean sixth room, split R2 as its own Wire chase between courier and cab. Mid-consist double-cab (L3) is the Hammerhead artifact — narrate sealed engineering rather than a second drive cab.

Players still learn the exact capsule car only on a **great success** in discovery; otherwise they search.
